code='def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    rotations = [grid, [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])], [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]], [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]]
    return [rotations[0][i] + rotations[1][i] for i in range(n)] + [rotations[3][i] + rotations[2][i] for i in range(n)]
